evidenceTable.claim: SPECTRUM documentation standards mandate a unique permanent accession number for tracking object provenance and validation layers.
evidenceTable.decisionImpact: Sets up the accession-number schema ('Accession 24.05') and catalog indexes on the frontend components.

evidenceTable.claim: OKLCH is considered baseline with support in Chrome 111+, Edge 111+, Firefox 113+, Safari 15.4+, but gamut-mapping clipper bugs exist in some browser renderers.
evidenceTable.decisionImpact: Specifies OKLCH color token formulas while defining fallback RGB values to prevent color clipping bugs.

evidenceTable.claim: Using vw units alone inside CSS clamp() disables user text zoom; designers must mix relative rem units into the preferred value to preserve zoom accessibility.
evidenceTable.decisionImpact: Sets the fluid font scale formulas to 'clamp(min, preferred + 1rem, max)' to satisfy WCAG 2.2 AA text zoom.

evidenceTable.claim: Typographic pairings that mix expressive serif display fonts with strict monospace metadata create a distinctive, honest neo-brutalist technical contrast.
evidenceTable.decisionImpact: Pairs classic display serif (EB Garamond) with slab typewriter (Courier Prime) and technical mono (JetBrains Mono) for UI labels.
